description: Adds the governed-SDD managed file `.codex/rules/meridian.rules`. In a trusted Codex project layer it allows the routine governed Git commands and a narrow read-only/validation Meridian command set, while force-push forms are forbidden and destructive branch deletion remains prompted. The file is intentionally unmarked: project-specific local rules are expected to be appended and are preserved by the ordinary three-way merge rather than capability-marker audit.
delta: Add `.codex/rules/meridian.rules` to governed-SDD's managed-file set only. The new template documents trust activation, offline decision checking, combined user-level rules, and the working-directory alternative to unsupported `git -C <path>` prefixes. It deliberately leaves state-changing Meridian commands, rebases, hard resets, amend commits, fetches, and reviewer author overrides to normal approval or a project-local literal rule.
verification: `templates/workflows/governed-sdd/.codex/rules/meridian.rules` contains only well-formed single-line `prefix_rule` entries and is enumerated for governed-SDD, not Lean Delivery

`codex execpolicy check --rules templates/workflows/governed-sdd/.codex/rules/meridian.rules -- <command...>` matches the rules decision table when Codex is on PATH; the test reports an explicit skip otherwise
a consumer without `.codex/` plans ADD and creates `.codex/rules/meridian.rules`; a pre-created local copy plans CONFLICT and is not overwritten
